verdict.rationale: Superset orchestrates CLI coding agents in isolated worktrees, so autonomy controls are a fair axis for it. The evidence never documents tiered autonomy or permission levels that govern which agent actions run without confirmation. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: notifications when an agent pauses for input, and diff review after the fact.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can set tiered autonomy levels controlling what an agent can do without manual confirmation
